title: docs(skills): objectstack-upgrade teaches the stored pass before 18.3 drops the ≤16.x conversions
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xYEtCvd5esC5k6dbFvWLihm)_
Fixes #26303

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `objectstack-upgrade` 技能不再教「16 时代存下的 `sys_metadata` 行读时会被永远自动改写、不必动」;改为:18.3 去掉 ≤16.x 的转换后这类行不再读时改写,所以要在 18.2 或更早版本上先跑一次 `os migrate meta --stored --apply --yes` 再升级。eval 4 同步改写,新增 eval 5 直接问「18.1 想直升 18.3」。
- **为什么改:** 去掉 ≤16.x 转换的改动已合入 main、随 18.3 发布,它的 changeset 写明此类行「is no longer rewritten at read」;技能原文照做的客户升到 18.3 后,存量行会永远停在旧形状,而 18.3 上的存量迁移也已救不回来。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改对外技能文本、报告模板一行与 eval,不动代码、schema、命令与行为;两份受 token 棘轮约束的文件都在天花板内、上限行未动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** ① `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` 的 "Stored rows" 一节(两段改写)与 § 3.6 末句;② `evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json` 的 eval 4 改句与新 eval 5;③ `references/examples-upgrade.md` 报告模板「Pending, per deployment」的存量迁移一行。
- **两分钟验证:** `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs` 均绿,且 `grep -n "rehydrates in its protocol-17" skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` 零命中。
- **需要你做的:** 审批本 PR(`skills/**` 是 Tier H 治理面,批准后由席位落地)。

## What changes

The 18.3 changeset `.changeset/25767-retire-16x-retirement-kits.md` (pending in the Version Packages PR) removes the 50 D2 conversions retired at or below 16.x, and its **Stored rows** bullet says a `sys_metadata` row still in such a shape "is no longer rewritten at read; canonicalize it once with `os migrate meta --stored --apply` on 18.2 or earlier, before moving to 18.3". The published upgrade skill still taught the opposite. This PR is the stored-rows half the card still owes (the floor half fell away under ruling 6434038284 on #25767: `MIGRATION_SUPPORT_FLOOR` stays 16, so `os migrate meta --from 16` and eval 1 are untouched).

- **`SKILL.md` § "Stored rows".** Heading and two paragraphs rewritten: `applyConversionsToStoredItem` replays the conversions the installed release still carries (load-path-retired ones included); 18.3 drops those retired at or below 16.x, so such a row is no longer rewritten; ⛔ run the stored pass before you move (on 18.2 or earlier for such a row). The removed sentences are the two the card names: "including entries retired from the load path ... A row written under protocol 16 therefore rehydrates in its protocol-17 shape without anybody editing it" and "To make it durable, run the stored pass". The command block, the `--yes` warning and the `--from` note are unchanged.
- **`SKILL.md` § 3.6.** "the read-time rehydration is still the guarantee" becomes "so get `0` before you move" — the same claim in its second place.
- **`references/examples-upgrade.md`** report template: the stored-pass checklist line said "rows rehydrate correctly today; this makes it durable"; it now says the pass is owed "before any release that drops their conversions".
- **`evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json`.** Eval 4's expected answer says stored rows rehydrate only while the installed release carries their conversions and runs the stored pass before moving past 18.2; its assertions are unchanged. New eval 5 (Chinese prompt, like eval 1): on 18.1, going straight to 18.3, rows from 16 read fine today; the expected answer runs `--stored`, `--stored --apply --yes` and `--stored --json` (exit 0) on 18.1 before the bump, and refuses both hand-editing `sys_metadata` and bumping first.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/26303-upgrade-skill-stored-rows-before-18-3.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, carrying both declaration lines.

## Tests

No code path changes, so no unit test applies; the teaching is exercised by eval 4 (amended) and eval 5 (new). The skill gates the card names are green on `3bf0627876`: `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-examples` (280 prose examples type-check across 3 surfaces). The full derived set is under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

**Line and token readings** (tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `3bf0627876` against base `b15b634c16`; lines by `wc -l`, tokens by the token ratchet's `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)` over the whole file):

| File | Lines before → after | Tokens before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` | 483 → 481 (−2) | 6176 → 6171 (ratchet's priced count after: 6166, ceiling 6188) |
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/references/examples-upgrade.md` | 119 → 119 (0) | 1195 → 1194 (ceiling 1197) |
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json` | 45 → 55 (+10) | 1033 → 1314 (eval fixture, measured, not ratcheted) |

| **Catalog** sum of all 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md` | 4554 → 4552 (−2) | — |

No ceiling row moves: the new teaching is paid for inside the stale sentences it replaces.

**Premise readings.** At tag `@objectstack/spec@18.2.0` (`27f38ada49`) `packages/spec/src` carries 45 conversions with `retiredAfter` 16.x and 5 with 15.x; at `b15b634c16` it carries 0. `packages/spec/package.json` on the base reads `18.2.0`, so the drop ships in the next release, 18.3, per the changeset.

**Scope.** The seat's brief named § "Stored rows" and the eval; § 3.6's last sentence and the report-template line state the same claim, so they were corrected in the same stroke (stale lines of the claim this card names, nothing else removed).

**Observed, not filed (unrehearsed drift, outside this file surface):** two code headers still state the pre-18.3 policy — `packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts` ("D3 keeps every conversion forever precisely so any past major can replay forward") and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-migration.ts` ("a row written under any past protocol is *served* canonical forever"); Prime Directive #12 in `AGENTS.md` says every rehydration seam replays "the full conversion chain — retired entries included". None is published teaching; carrier: none.
